snippet.title: Something Is Being Built in the Dark… | Toycrafter Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Something is being built in the dark… and it isn’t waiting for you

Toycrafter is a psychological horror experience set inside a lonely workshop where tools move, dolls rearrange themselves, and sculptures appear that you don’t remember creating.

Cut, paint, and assemble disturbing doll sculptures.
Keep the workshop tidy.
Ignore the sounds behind you.
And always lock the door before you leave.
